description_zh: 调用CreateFlowlog接口创建流日志实例
kebab_example: aliyun smartag create-flow-log --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --description test --name sag-flowlog-1 --active-aging 300 --inactive-aging 15 --output-type all --sls-region-id cn-shanghai --project-name sag-flowlog-shanghai --logstore-name config-operation-log --netflow-server-ip 192.168.0.2 --netflow-server-port 9995 --netflow-version V9 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateFlowLog

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region to which the flow log belongs.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
流日志实例的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The description of the flow log
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The name of the flow log
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The output interval under active connections. Valid values: 60 to 6000. Unit: seconds. Default value: 300
parameters.help_zh: 活跃流输出间隔。取值范围：60~6000，单位：秒。默认值为300秒
parameters.name: active_aging

parameters.help_en: The output interval under inactive connections. Valid values: 10 to 600. Unit: seconds. Default value: 15
parameters.help_zh: 非活跃流输出间隔。取值范围：10~600，单位：秒。默认值为15秒
parameters.name: inactive_aging

parameters.help_en:
The type of the flow log. Valid values:

sls: The flow log is stored in Log Service.
netflow: The flow log is stored on a NetFlow collector.
all: The flow log is stored both in Log Service and on a NetFlow collector
parameters.help_zh:
流日志输出类型，取值：

sls：流日志存储在阿里云日志服务中。

netflow：流日志存储在您配置的Netflow服务器上。

all：流日志同时存储在阿里云日志服务和您配置的Netflow服务器上
parameters.name: output_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where Log Service is deployed.

If OutputType is set to sls or all, this parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
日志服务的地域ID。

流日志输出类型为sls或all时需填写该项
parameters.name: sls_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The project in Log Service.

If OutputType is set to sls or all, this parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
日志服务的Project。

流日志输出类型为sls或all时需填写该项
parameters.name: project_name

parameters.help_en:
The Logstore in Log Service.

If OutputType is set to sls or all, this parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
日志服务的Logstore。

流日志输出类型为sls或者all时需填写该项
parameters.name: logstore_name

parameters.help_en:
The IP address of the NetFlow collector where the flow log is stored.

If OutputType is set to netflow or all, this parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
存储流日志的Netflow服务器地址。

流日志输出类型为netflow或all时需填写该项
parameters.name: netflow_server_ip

parameters.help_en:
The port number of the NetFlow collector where the flow log is stored. Default value: 9995.

If OutputType is set to netflow or all, this parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
存储流日志的Netflow服务器端口，默认值为9995。

流日志输出类型为netflow或all时需填写该项
parameters.name: netflow_server_port

parameters.help_en:
The version of the NetFlow collector where the flow log is stored. Valid values: V5, V9, and V10. Default value: V9.

If OutputType is set to netflow or all, this parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
存储流日志时使用的Netflow协议版本号，取值：V5、V9和V10，默认值为V9。

流日志输出类型为netflow或all时需填写该项
parameters.name: netflow_version

FlowLogId.description_en: The ID of the flow log

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group to which the flow log belongs
ResourceGroupId.description_zh: 流日志实例所属资源组ID
